title: Translate integer logic
prompt: Return whether elixir can pay 6 for X-Bow. Example: affordable(6) is True.
tests:
assert affordable(6) is True, 'Six elixir should afford X-Bow'
assert affordable(5) is False, 'Five elixir cannot pay six'
assert affordable(10), 'Ten elixir should afford X-Bow'

title: Independent player arrays
prompt: Return a fresh two-by-eight list filled with level. Example: decks(16)[1][0] is 16. Rows must be independent.
tests:
a=decks(16)
assert len(a)==2 and all(len(r)==8 for r in a), 'Need two sides and eight slots'
assert all(v==16 for r in a for v in r), 'Every starting level should be 16'
a[0][0]=1
assert a[1][0]==16, 'The two sides must not share one inner list'
hint: Use an inner and outer comprehension.
solution:
def decks(level):
    return [[level for _ in range(8)] for _ in range(2)]

title: Convert facade coordinates

starter:
